name: @taste-and-see/api-gateway
description: Backend-for-Frontend (PDD §7.1, §7.2 service inventory entry #1). NestJS 11 + Node 22 fetch. Phase-1 (TS-140) ships: env validation, AccessTokenGuard verifying service-identity-minted JWTs once at the edge, signed internal-trust headers (HMAC-SHA256) propagated to every downstream service so the trust boundary collapses from N services to 1, Redis-backed sliding-window rate limiter with per-route policy, ZodValidationPipe + RFC 7807 filter, ServiceRegistry + DownstreamHttpClient with AbortController-backed timeouts, /healthz + /readyz (readyz pings Redis + downstream /healthz endpoints), one verified-from-token /api/v1/me endpoint that demonstrates the auth context propagation, and one proxy endpoint /api/v1/plans that exercises the downstream HTTP client end-to-end. Owns NO database — pure routing + auth + rate-limit + aggregation surface. Downstream-side verification of the trust headers + per-service permission gating + OpenTelemetry tracing land as TS-140 follow-ups.
